capability: Remote on-device task lifecycle, steering receipts and uncertain-delivery handling
evidence: Source: https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika/tree/4af80975822bb0fe71e58d490ad7354202030094. Read README, Apache-2.0 license, docs/mcp.en.md, docs/dev/remote-mcp.md, docs/modes.en.md and pinned McpTaskTools.kt/RemoteTasks.kt. File bytes matched Git blob hashes; no APK, relay, setup command or foreign test was run.

Observed in task tool definitions and state mapping: start returns a task identity; wait/status distinguish queued, paused, user-only waiting and terminal states. Steering acceptance is not execution. Documentation distinguishes delivery_unknown/outcome_unknown from a safe retry and states that cancellation cannot undo an executed action. Request-id persistence, gateway controls and phone-only confirmations are documented contracts, not verified end-to-end behavior in this run.

Existing dmux attempt-completion already binds task/attempt results and treats timeout as uncertain; E2E retry guidance reconciles durable state before replay; operator-approval-loop separates authorization, delivery claims and unknown outcomes. MCP/server and security skills own protocol and access boundaries. These transferable foundations do not justify another orchestration skill.

The Android background-device/relay adapter and remote credential/confirmation policies need a concrete authorized integration, compatible device and live permission/reconnect/cancellation tests. Mika local Ask/Autonomous defaults are product policy and are not adopted as owner authorization.
reason: Basic lifecycle and replay-safety lessons are already covered. Defer the specialized remote Android runtime: source reading does not establish compatibility, enforcement or a current Database integration need.
